versions.changelog:
- Removed the README.md file from the project.
- Documentation and interface remain unchanged; skill usage is not affected.

1688-product-search v1.0.1

- Added comprehensive documentation (SKILL.md) detailing all 9 core product search APIs, usage methods, and authentication configuration.
- Documented unified token cache mechanism supporting automatic token refresh and shared authentication across all 1688 Skills.
- Expanded usage instructions for multilingual search, category queries, image search (with smart compression), product recommendation, pool-based queries, and handling of common errors.
- Provided detailed guidance on how to obtain and configure required 1688 API credentials.
- Listed important usage tips and interface trigger rules to ensure effective integration and troubleshooting.
